build_arg_parser: build an ArgParser from CLI args and optionally load arguments from a config file
parse_string: parse a string value for a given key from the ArgParser with a default fallback
parse_ints: parse a list of integer values for a given key from the ArgParser
load_args: load command-line argument strings into the ArgParser key-value table
load_file: load arguments from a file into the ArgParser by parsing key-value pairs
